piezas.titulo: Written production: Numbers, age and basic details
texto: Guided writing: age and quantities. Practise writing declarative sentences with numbers. Pattern 1: [Pronoun] + อายุ + [Number in Thai] + ปี + [ครับ/ค่ะ]. Pattern 2: [Place] + มี + [Number] + [Classifier]. Remember that the numbers 1 to 5 are written «หนึ่ง, สอง, สาม, สี่, ห้า» and 20 is written «ยี่สิบ». Make sure there are no spaces between the number and its classifier.
